global.css:35-52 :root and :root[data-theme=frost-light] set --bg:#f4f5f7, --surface:#ffffff, --primary:#4f46e5, --secondary:#0891b2, --text:#1f2329, --text-2:#6b7280, --border:#e5e7eb. Frost Dark variant at lines 55-69 uses the same token structure with --primary:#818cf8.

App.vue:14 initializes theme to 'frost-light'. global.css:35-52 selector applies Frost Light tokens to :root unconditionally (the bare :root matches with no data-theme set), so the default theme uses --bg #F4F5F7, --surface #FFFFFF, --primary #4F46E5, --text #1F2329.

App.vue:83-86 toggleTheme() only changes theme.value and document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', theme.value). No structural DOM changes; only root token variables differ between the frost-light and frost-dark blocks in global.css.

Motion tokens exist (global.css:26-32: --dur-fast 150ms, --dur-base 280ms, --dur-slow 520ms, --ease, --ease-spring) and the keyframe card-in (line 86-89) is defined using only opacity/transform. However, the 'animate-card-in' class referenced on each card (WallpaperGrid.vue:75) is NOT registered as a Tailwind v4 custom animation — only --animate-fade-in, --animate-pop, --animate-shimmer are declared in @theme (global.css:20-22). The generated production CSS (dist/assets/index-Dhq9M7RF.css) contains no .animate-card-in rule, so the staggered upward float entrance does not actually run at runtime — cards mount instantly. Stagger delay is set inline (WallpaperGrid.vue:76) but no animation is bound to consume it. Skeleton placeholder is also absent. The 'transform/opacity only' and 'motion tokens' portions pass; the 'staggered card entrance' portion is unimplemented at runtime.

WallpaperGrid.vue:75 'transition-transform duration-[var(--dur-base)] hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-md' uses transform only on hover. DetailDrawer.vue:135-143 .drawer-enter/leave transitions use only 'transform' and 'opacity' with var(--dur-base) and var(--ease).

global.css:148-157 @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) sets animation-duration: 0.001ms !important, animation-iteration-count: 1 !important, transition-duration: 0.001ms !important, scroll-behavior: auto !important, applied globally to *, *::before, *::after.

risks: A19: 'animate-card-in' Tailwind class is not registered in @theme (only --animate-fade-in, --animate-pop, --animate-shimmer are). The keyframe @keyframes card-in is defined in global.css but the production CSS contains no .animate-card-in rule, so the staggered card entrance animation is silently non-functional at runtime. Cards appear instantly without fade-in. The inline animationDelay is set but unused.
A19: A skeleton placeholder for lazy-loaded cards is not implemented in WallpaperGrid; the spec calls for one alongside the staggered entrance.

A7: cancelAutoClose sets remain.value=0 (line 32) instead of freezing the ring at its current value — the visual collapses the ring even though the drawer itself stays open. Spec A7 only requires the timer be cancellable, which is satisfied, but a 'freeze at current value' interpretation of the behavior is not implemented.

A3: 'persists within the session' is satisfied via component-local ref() (activeCat, sort) which survive navigation within the SPA but reset on full app reload. This is consistent with the spec wording.
result.summary: Build (vue-tsc + vite build) passes cleanly (exit 0). 20 of 21 acceptance items are independently verified against source. A19 fails because the spec's required 'staggered card entrance' is not actually functional at runtime: WallpaperGrid.vue references an 'animate-card-in' Tailwind class that is not registered in @theme and therefore not generated in the production CSS, so the @keyframes card-in rule never fires and cards mount instantly. All other items (A1–A18, A20, A21) pass with concrete file:line evidence. Verdict: fail.
